heading: INT. GENERATION SHIP "HALCYON" - SEED VAULT - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. GENERATION SHIP "HALCYON" - SEED VAULT - NIGHT CYCLE
A long white corridor lined with frost-skinned drawers.
Each is labeled in small black type: wheat, barley, lentil, cacao.
Cold exhales from the vents.
A low pump hum.
ENGINEER AKINYI WAMBUGU, 40s, thermal gloves, a utility belt, checks a sensor panel.
ARCHIVIST VOSS, 50s, a cardigan too thin for the temperature, stands at the end of the aisle holding a slim black case against her chest.
You're not on the roster.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: I'm the Archivist. I'm always on the roster.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Not for this deck. Not at this hour.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: Voss does not answer.
She walks the aisle, running her fingertips along the frosted drawers.
Akinyi watches the case.
That's a lot of case for a woman who inventories paper.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: It's only an old habit.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Show me.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: Voss stops at a drawer marked SOLANUM TUBEROSUM.
Pulls the handle.
A tray of small grey tubers slides out under glass.
She sets the case on the counter.
Clicks the lock.
Does not open it.
You know what we've lost in four generations, Akinyi?
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Eleven strains of rice. Three of coffee.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: Four hundred and six varieties. I counted every one.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: She slides the case a few centimeters toward the potatoes.
Akinyi's eyes flick to the panel.
The temperature reading has not changed.
Neither has her breathing.
So what's in the case?
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: Things the Council doesn't want to be counted.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: That's contraband.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: That's a library.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Akinyi pulls a data slate from her belt.
Taps it.
A tone sounds in the ceiling.
You just called them.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: I called the Captain. He asked me to.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: Voss nods.
Slow.
Her hand lifts from the case, rests flat on the cold metal beside it.
Then do it. Open the drawer. Put it all in the shredder. Four hundred and six.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: I can't.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: You can. You're holding the key.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: Akinyi looks down.
In her palm, a brass key.
She does not know when she took it from her belt.
You knew I'd bring it.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: I knew you'd bring it.
units.name: VOSS

units.text: The vents shudder.
Steam rolls along the floor.
Footsteps, far off.
Many.
Akinyi lays the key on the counter, next to the case, carefully, as though it were something alive.
Then you've got four minutes.
units.name: AKINYI

units.text: Voss opens the case.
